summary: Allstate's nationwide website and app outage is now in its fourth day, and the company has not said why. The FBI is still investigating a break-in at its police database. No official source links these events, and stocks, Bitcoin and oil moved on known news.

events.title: Allstate nationwide website, app and payment outage, now several days
events.impact: Customers and agents report trouble with logins, payments and claims. Allstate says customers will not lose coverage or be charged late fees. It has given no restoration time.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Allstate has not given a cause. One blog claims an AI switch caused it, but that claim comes from one source and is not backed up.

events.title: FBI investigating break-in at its national crime database
events.impact: Police use this database for warrant checks and stolen property records. Nobody has said what was taken, whether records changed, or whether police lost access.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Reports rely on unnamed sources. No group has claimed it and no official link to the September FBI jobs portal breach.

events.title: USDA cyber incident hit farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm loan, payment and conservation software was disrupted. As of Nov 24, USDA had not said if everything is back or whether financial data was taken.
events.stated_cause: A USDA official said systems were shut down over a cyber threat and no personal data was lost. No attacker has been named.

events.title: More tanker mine reports in Strait of Hormuz; Houthis claim Saudi refinery hit
events.impact: Brent crude rose to about 95 dollars early Thursday, then eased to near 94 in later reports. Tanker tracker Kpler reports lower crude flows out of the Gulf.
events.stated_cause: Iranian state media says tankers hit mines. These claims are not independently confirmed. The Houthis claimed the Ras Tanura refinery attack.

events.title: Thanksgiving storm cuts power to about 300,000-500,000 customers
events.impact: Outages are worst in Virginia, Missouri and North Carolina. Hundreds of flights are canceled or delayed. The worst is forecast later today for the Northeast.
events.stated_cause: Weather: a coastal nor'easter and a winter storm. National Weather Service warnings point to high winds and flooding.

events.title: Bitcoin near 58-61K USD, down about 5-8% on the week
events.impact: Coinbase 58,651 (-6% week). CoinGecko 60,741 (+4.7% day, -4.7% week). Coinglass 58,244 (-7.5% week). Sources differ because of timing. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Coinglass data shows mostly long-position liquidations and ETF outflows.

events.title: Wild swing in US stocks Wednesday, then recovery; markets closed today
events.impact: Nov 25 close: S&P 500 7,182.78 (-0.25%), Dow 50,182.95 (+0.33%), Nasdaq 23,585.80 (-0.62%). US markets are closed for Thanksgiving.
events.stated_cause: Reports point to hot inflation data, AI profit worries and tariff plans. No technical fault or cyber attack is reported. I found no trading halts.

events.title: CISA adds 10 more actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Nov 25 additions cover Danfoss, HPE Juniper, Mitel and Vates products. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites active exploitation. It names no attacker and does not tie the flaws to the FBI, USDA or Allstate incidents.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows reduced performance on Sites and Services
events.impact: Status feed lists Sites and Services as degraded, last changed 14:42 UTC today. I found no news report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

events.title: Reported separate breach of CIA and intelligence office network
events.impact: Said to involve an unclassified open-source analysis network. Scope unknown. No new reporting found this run.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Unnamed sources only. No agency statement and no second independent source.

connection_assessment.reasoning: Allstate has not said what caused its outage. The FBI and USDA incidents are called cyber intrusions, but no attacker is named. Stocks, Bitcoin and oil moved on inflation, AI and Middle East news, and the power cuts are from weather. No official source links any of these.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same company or attacker for Allstate, the FBI and USDA, or several big systems failing at the same moment.

alert.reason: Allstate's outage is confirmed and long-running, but it is a single company with no reported link to other incidents.

prep_note: If you use Allstate, keep proof of your policy and call your local agent for claims or payments. Expect Thanksgiving storm travel delays and power cuts in the Mid-Atlantic and Northeast. Charge phones and keep some cash on hand.
